items.title: How AI-native companies turn workflows into operating capability
items.content: Basis, Clay, and Exa Labs use AI agents to improve onboarding, account management, and developer integrations. See what enterprise leaders can apply.
items.contentSnippet: Basis, Clay, and Exa Labs use AI agents to improve onboarding, account management, and developer integrations. See what enterprise leaders can apply.
items.summary: 报道了Basis、Clay和Exa Labs三家AI原生公司如何利用AI代理改进企业工作流程，包括员工入职、客户账户管理和开发者工具集成。内容为行业应用趋势概述，面向企业领导者提供参考，但缺少具体技术架构或实现细节。
items.ai_reason: AI Agent在实际企业场景（入职、账户管理、开发者集成）的应用案例，属于核心关注领域但为浅层报道，缺乏技术实现细节
